name: editable script card with a word highlighted for a fix
looks: A narration script card lists several lines of text under the second step's headline. One word in the middle gets a small coloured underline and an "edited" tag as if just corrected, and an approve button at the bottom corner fills in solid once pressed.
build: glass-ui-flow: the card's text is static DOM, the edited word gets a coloured underline and tag fading in on a short pop; the approve button's fill animates on press (scale 0.95, colour ramps from outline to solid) with a cursor arriving just before.
sound: A soft click on the edit tag, a confirming chime on approve.
prompt: Show a card of generated text with one small phrase marked as edited, a coloured underline and a small tag calling it out. End on a plain approve button filling solid the moment it is pressed, so the viewer sees a human stayed in control of the output.
